explication: ZapFast is a native Rust/egui WhatsApp companion client. The principal workflow is: a desktop user launches the app, links it to a phone, receives synchronized chats through the WhatsApp protocol, stores them in an encrypted local archive, and views or modifies conversations through the native UI. The UI dispatches commands through App to the backend worker, which returns events and performs protocol, history, attachment, poll, and profile operations. Sampled source confirms orchestration and encrypted storage; several UI feature paths are represented from the tree and README but their internal call wiring was not sampled.
